icon.description: An environment's icon, by name, one of the ten the enum lists (ADR 0025's fixed set): each client draws the name its own way, and the terminal UI draws none.

colour.description: An environment's colour, by name: red, orange, amber, yellow, lime, green, teal, cyan, blue, indigo, violet or pink. Never a literal: each client draws it with the theme's token for the name.

description: An environment's name, icon and colour, as it holds them now: what every client draws its badge from.
